exposure: Pulmonary hypertension (PH) severity (none, mild, moderate, severe)
cohort: Infants born less than 32 weeks of gestational age with BPD who underwent echocardiography at 36-38 weeks postmenstrual age
finding: Echocardiogram-assessed PH severity is associated with mortality and hospital readmission in very preterm infants with BPD.
